news.title: Braves activate Ronald Acuña Jr. for Mets series
news.summary: The Atlanta Braves activated Ronald Acuña Jr. off the injured list following his rehabilitation assignment with Triple-A Gwinnett. The Braves optioned Brewer Hicklen to Gwinnett to make room for Acuña

news.title: Motorcyclist critically injured after crash on Ernest Barrett Pkwy
news.summary: A Saturday afternoon crash in Marietta left a motorcyclist fighting for life after separating from the bike on Ernest Barrett Parkway, police said.

news.title: Woman accused of murder following Douglasville domestic incident
news.summary: A domestic violence encounter in Douglasville turned deadly Thursday after a man died from severe injuries, according to authorities.

news.title: Detainee dies following cardiac arrest at Cobb County jail
news.summary: A 64-year-old detainee died at Kennestone Hospital after going into cardiac arrest while held at the Cobb County Adult Detention Center, law enforcement officials announced Monday.

news.title: Atlanta marks 30 years since Centennial Olympic Park bombing
news.summary: Monday marks 30 years since the deadly Centennial Olympic Park bombing shook Atlanta during the 1996 Summer Olympic Games, killing two people and injuring over 100 others.

news.title: Atlanta to gather for vigil to remember woman, dog brutally killed in Piedmont Park 5 years after murders
news.summary: Katie Janness' killing approaches, family, friends and community members are preparing to gather in her memory while once again calling for answers.
